correctness.rationale: A plane-straddling argument computes P(containment|x,y)=theta/(4pi); rotation invariance kills the first Hoeffding projection; Funk--Hecke and a Legendre integral give the complete signed odd spectrum and Hilbert--Schmidt convergence. Standard canonical U-statistic theory yields the centered chi-square series. The telescoping spectral first moment gives the sharp upper support endpoint and the Hilbert--Schmidt norm gives variance 9(pi²-8)/(8pi²). A standalone seed-controlled script verifies conditional probabilities, 13 odd and 8 even eigenvalues, spectral variance sum, and finite-depth simulations; finite checks are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A generic geometric probability identity supplies only the expected fraction 1/8; for a centered 3D sample its uncertainty is non-Gaussian on the 1/n scale. The result gives explicit usable variance, full limiting law and one-sided support, clarifies rank-two degeneracy, and holds for arbitrary radial distributions with uniform directions. These facts are motivated by central simplicial depth as a multivariate location/depth statistic, not by an artificial parameter slice.
